change: Removed secondary Quads (Rectus Femoris). The exercise description specifies knees bent with heels on the floor — legs are stationary, so the hip flexors (including Rectus Femoris) are not meaningfully recruited. Hip flexor secondary is only relevant when legs are lifted/moving (bicycle crunch variant). With fixed feet, abs and obliques are the prime movers and there are no meaningful secondary muscles in this variation.
